items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: In Don's band Squirrel's I fooled with Bob Tsagary's bass and learned a little more

ctx.x: But, you see, I tell you, Milt, I started to fooling with the bass when Billy Taylor first brought the bass fiddle to McKinney's band. I used to take his bass and I used to fool with it and I learned a little bit about it, a little more, a little more. In Don's band Squirrel's I fooled with Bob Tsagary's bass and learned a little more, a little more, and a little more. And I played a little tuba, too, you know. So when I got to you and I watched you and watched different things, you know, you have to be…
